( 1) For the purpose of advising the Director on the Advisory out of his functions under this Act, there shall be an Board Advisory Board consisting of the Director as Chairman and 5 other members to be appointed by the Minister.

(2) The Board shall advise the Director on such matters as the Director may from time to time refer to it and on such matters as the Board may think fit. 6 CAP. 116 Brunei National Archives

(3) Three members of the Board shall form a quorum. ( 4) The Board shall determine its own procedure.

heading.en: The Director may act in opposition to Advisory

text.en:
The Director may, after consultation with the Minis-- The Director in ter, act in opposition to the advice given to him by the Advisory Board, if in any case he shall think fit to do so, but

(a) he shall record fully in writing for inclusion in the minutes of the proceedings of the Advisory the grounds and reasons for his decision; and

(b) it shall be competent for any member of the Advisory Board to require that there shall be recorded in the minutes aforesaid any advice or opinion that he may have given upon the question in dispute, and the grounds therefor.
